query:
SELECT object_key FROM stored_blobs b WHERE touched_at<now()-interval '1 day' AND ($1 OR b.object_key LIKE 'file:%')
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM scans WHERE raw_report_ref=b.object_key)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM artifact_refs a WHERE a.object_key=b.object_key AND a.owned)
        ORDER BY touched_at,object_key LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
